reference_notes: VHS/film-grain photo-real, matched to the recent run of Shorts. Real brand names/logos/signage are allowed per standing pipeline policy, but a specific trademarked cartoon character's likeness (e.g. an exact known cereal mascot) is a different, higher-risk kind of reproduction than a brand name or logo, so the mascot and on-screen cartoon stay original/generic rather than a specific copyrighted character design.
